name: frp-agent-extension
description: VS Code Chat Agent for File Reception Portal - manage email/SFTP monitoring jobs, deal coverage, and application logs.

chatParticipants.name: frp
chatParticipants.description: Manage email and SFTP monitoring jobs, query deal coverage, analyze logs, and deploy Settings.xml changes.

commands.name: sync_logs
commands.description: Explicitly sync application logs on demand

commands.name: jobs
commands.description: Search, filter, and validate email/SFTP monitoring jobs

commands.name: jobXML
commands.description: Legacy deterministic email lookup using Settings.xml

commands.name: jobSQLite
commands.description: Legacy deterministic email lookup using the SQLite cache

commands.name: jobXMLEmail
commands.description: Deterministic email job lookup using Settings.xml

commands.name: jobSQLiteEmail
commands.description: Deterministic email job lookup using the SQLite cache

commands.name: jobXMLSftp
commands.description: Deterministic SFTP job lookup using Settings.xml

commands.name: jobSQLiteSftp
commands.description: Deterministic SFTP job lookup using the SQLite cache

commands.name: deals
commands.description: Query deal coverage, servicer dossiers, and DID mappings

commands.name: deploy
commands.description: Save Settings.xml, manage backups, list restore points

commands.name: clone
commands.description: Deterministically clone a job by ServicerID with per-tag editing and XML preview

commands.name: triage
commands.description: Triage incoming emails against job configurations (Phase 3)

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: Advanced analysis: trends, health checks, consolidation (Phase 4)

commands.name: staging
commands.description: Template staging: processing status, failures, durations, pipeline view (Phase 5)

commands.name: testbench
commands.description: Run classifier test bench against golden test cases (Phase 8)

commands.name: rebuild-db
commands.description: Rebuild the SQLite job-config cache from Settings.xml (email + SFTP)

commands.title: FRP Agent: Run Inline Chat Action

frpAgent.prod.description: Database mode. true = MSSQL production, false = MySQL local development.

frpAgent.mssqlServer.description: MSSQL server name (e.g. VMCKSA69901M0VX.us-bank-dns.com,49001). Required when Prod mode is enabled.

frpAgent.mssqlDatabase.description: MSSQL database name (e.g. Servicing). Required when Prod mode is enabled.

frpAgent.outlookSettingsPath.description: Absolute path to the email monitoring Settings.xml file.

frpAgent.sftpSettingsPath.description: Absolute path to the SFTP monitoring Settings.xml file.

frpAgent.sftpLogFolder.description: Folder containing SFTP monitor log files.

frpAgent.logRetentionMonths.description: Months of log data to retain in the SQLite index.

frpAgent.logDbPath.description: Absolute path to the shared SQLite log-index database (e.g. \\server\share\frp_logs.db). Must be set for log analytics.

frpAgent.model.description: LLM for response generation. 'auto' uses your active Copilot model.

frpAgent.cacheDbPath.description: Absolute path to the SQLite job-config cache database. Enables fast search/detail queries over Settings.xml. Run 'frp xml rebuild-db' to populate.

frpAgent.enableDeterministicJobExperimen.description: Enable deterministic slash commands for direct email and SFTP job lookup without LLM generation, including /jobXMLEmail, /jobSQLiteEmail, /jobXMLSftp, /jobSQLiteSftp, plus legacy email aliases /jobXML and /jobSQLite.
